module_role: Fibre Channel controller / host bus adapter (HBA) datapath: a five-level FC-0..FC-4 stack that frames upper-level-protocol traffic (FCP=SCSI, FC-NVMe, IP, FICON) into FC-2 frames (24-byte header + <=2112 B payload + 32-bit CRC), groups them into sequences and exchanges, applies BB_Credit/EE_Credit flow control and classes of service, performs FLOGI/PLOGI/PRLI login, and serializes over an FC-0 SerDes at 1-128 GFC with 8b/10b or 64b/66b encoding.
topology_description: A full-duplex serial link (one Tx + one Rx lane). Deployed point-to-point (two N_Ports), as an arbitrated loop (FC-AL, up to 126 NL_Ports), or attached to a switched fabric via F_Ports (switches route by 24-bit address and interconnect through E_Ports).

integration_overview.host_side_register_spec: Login service parameters (FLOGI/PLOGI/PRLI Common + Class + FCP Service Parameters) plus an HBA/controller implementation-defined control/status register set.

interface_categories: FC-4 ULP mapping — FCP (SCSI), FC-NVMe, IP over FC, FICON.
FC-3 common services — striping, hunt groups, multicast.
FC-2 framing/signaling — frame, sequence, exchange, flow control, classes of service, login.
FC-1 transmission — 8b/10b or 64b/66b encoding, ordered sets.
FC-0 physical — SerDes Tx/Rx, REFCLK, gigabaud signaling.
default_signal_values_when_omitted: Transmit IDLE ordered sets when no frames flow; NOS/OLS when the link is not operational.
soc_dependent_items: Port type (N_Port for an end device; F/E_Port for a switch).
Maximum GFC rate and encoding (8b/10b vs 64b/66b SerDes).
BB_Credit depth (buffer count) and supported classes of service.
Optional FCoE encapsulation over lossless Ethernet.
